compounddef.title: FFT vs. GPU Convolution and Morphological Expansion

detaileddescription.para: This document records the experimental evaluation of 2D Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithms as potential alternatives to spatial GPU implementations for convolution and morphological operations.

sect1.title: 1. Context and Motivation
sect1.para: Spatial filtering on large kernels can become computationally demanding with direct convolution, which scales with the kernel area $\mathcal{O}(K^2)$. In contrast, frequency-domain convolution via FFT operates in $\mathcal{O}(N \log N)$ independent of kernel radius:
